snippet.title: Not 35! 🎂 Riddle #14 Answer + Riddle #15: How Much Is the Pen? 🖊️ #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's mystery: when Person 1 was 6 years old, Person 2 was half as old. Today Person 1 is 70. How old is Person 2?

ANSWER: 67! Half of 6 is 3, so back then Person 2 was 3. That means Person 2 is always 3 years younger: the gap never changes. 70 - 3 = 67 (not 35: 'half' was only true at that moment).

RIDDLE #15: Person 1 buys a pen and a notebook. Together they cost £1.10. The notebook costs exactly £1 more than the pen. How much does the pen cost?

Is it 1) 10p, 2) 5p or 3) 1p? Comment 1, 2 or 3 👇 The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
